intro: The Burning Blade Medallion is a dark talisman carried by cultists lurking within the Valley of Trials. Guarded by dark magic in the depths of the Burning Blade Coven, it serves as direct proof of demonic corruption attempting to subvert the young warriors of Durotar.

p: Discovered deep inside the winding caverns of the Burning Blade Coven, the medallion is held by Yarrog Baneshadow, an agent of the sinister Burning Blade cult. Identified through the divinations of Zureetha Fargaze, the trinket channels dark power amidst the cult's impish familiars and felstalkers. Striking down its bearer and seizing the medallion cuts short an insidious attempt to undermine the Horde's training grounds from within Durotar itself.
